glossary.definition: (A) "Approved" means approved by the department of education and workforce and included on the list compiled by the department under section 3324.02 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 3324.02 through 3324.06 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Gifted" means students who perform or show potential for performing at remarkably high levels of accomplishment when compared to others of their age, experience, or environment and who are identified under division (A), (B), (C), or (D) of section 3324.03 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in this section and sections 3324.02 through 3324.06 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "School district" does not include a joint vocational school district.
